# 2 Baruch Chapter 66 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 66:1 — reference to Jeroboam's pattern

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "those-who-wickedly-followed the-work-of-Jeroboam" |
| LOGOS | "those who wickedly followed the work of Jeroboam" |
| PNEUMA | "those who wickedly carried on the work of Jeroboam" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Followed the work of Jeroboam' is the standard regnal formula echoing 1-2 Kings; PNEUMA's 'carried on' softens the evaluative force of the original.
